 With the victory, Chanmari FC, which was promoted to the Indian Football League (IFL) in 2025, maintained its unbeaten streak in the IFL this season.
 | Photo Credit: IFL Media
 Chanmari FC’s clinical performance produced a dominant 4-1 victory over Rajasthan United FC in the Indian Football League 2026-27, at the Vidyadhar Nagar Stadium here on Friday.
 It was Rajasthan United’s third straight home loss of the season.
 An own goal by Rajasthan United defender Pardeep Singh gave Chanmari the lead in the seventh minute, before Denilson Roldao doubled their advantage with an Olympic goal three minutes later.
 The home side halved the deficit in the 35th minute following a period of sustained pressure in the Chanmari half. Judah Garcia showcased his skills on the right wing before delivering an inviting ball into the box. Sabir Musah timed his jump to perfection between two defenders and powered a header into the back of the net to score his first goal of the season.
 Chanmari, however, restored its two-goal advantage against the run of play in the 57th minute, courtesy of another brilliant strike from Gabriel Paz. The Brazilian unleashed a rasping left-footed shot that beat the goalkeeper and crossed the line after crashing against the underside of the crossbar.
 Man of the Match Zothanmawia, who had a brilliant outing between the posts, proved to be Judah Garcia’s nemesis on the day, denying the Rajasthan United forward on multiple occasions. The Chanmari goalkeeper first thwarted a one-on-one attempt before producing another save to his right moments later. He also made himself big to force Garcia to send a clear-cut chance wide of the post.
 ALSO READ: Zomuansanga brace gives Nagaland United a comfortable win over Samaleswari SC 
 Chanmari capped its clinical performance with a fourth goal through Lalthanzuala in the 90th minute. Lalruatsanga played a perfectly weighted through ball into the striker’s path, and Lalthanzuala made no mistake with a clinical finish to score for the second consecutive match.
 Chanmari, which remains unbeaten in the season, moved to third place in the table with seven points from three matches, while Rajasthan United remained in eighth place with just three points from four games.
 Later in the day, table-topper Gokulam Kerala will take on Mohammedan Sporting at the Kishore Bharati Krirangan in Kolkata.
Match result
Rajasthan United FC - 1 (Sabir Musa 35’) lost to Chanmari FC - 4 (Pardeep Singh 7’ og, Denilson Roldao 10’, Gabriel Paz 57’, Lalthanzuala 90’)
